system.description: The Vizier's player can invoke this Charm when making an Occult roll. This Charm adds one die to that roll for each mote spent, to a maximum of (Attribute + Occult) dice. Characters can also use this Charm to enhance static values such as a Defense Value: roll one die per mote spent, with each success increasing the effective (Attribute + Occult) by two and raising an applicable DV by one. This Charm can be part of a Combo or used together with the Second Excellency, but is incompatible with the Third Excellency.
